Comparison chart between Power BI and Qlik Sense

Features Power BI Qlik Sense
Data sources Supports a wide range of data sources, including cloud-based and on-premise databases, Excel spreadsheets, and web-based data sources Supports a wide range of data sources, including cloud-based and on-premise databases, Excel spreadsheets, and web-based data sources
Data preparation Power Query Editor allows for data preparation and transformation within the Power BI environment Qlik Sense includes a data loading and transformation tool called Qlik Data Catalyst
Visualization Offers a wide range of interactive visualizations, including charts, graphs, and maps Offers a wide range of interactive visualizations, including charts, graphs, and maps
Collaboration Allows for sharing of reports and dashboards with others through the Power BI service or embedding in other applications Offers collaborative features, such as shared workspaces and discussion threads
Mobile accessibility Power BI mobile app available for iOS, Android, and Windows devices Qlik Sense mobile app available for iOS and Android devices
Cost Offers various pricing tiers, including a free version, as well as paid plans starting at $9.99 per user per month Offers various pricing tiers, including a free version, as well as paid plans starting at $30 per user per month
Learning curve User-friendly interface and easy-to-use drag-and-drop features make it relatively easy to learn and use Offers a steeper learning curve due to its more advanced data modeling and scripting capabilities
Customization Limited customization options for advanced users Offers more customization options for advanced users, including scripting and data modeling capabilities
Data security Offers robust data security features, including role-based access control and data encryption Offers robust data security features, including role-based access control and data encryption

Questionnaire

Ques.1) What is the major difference between Power BI and Qlik Sense?

Ans. Difference Between Power BI and Qlik Sense. Power BI is a major business tool used for business analytics purposes. At the same time, Qlik Sense is somewhat of a self-service tool through which we design reports and dashboards.

Ques.2) Is Qlik better than Power BI?

Ans. But, Power BI has a better advantage over QlikView for business analytics solutions. They are both with similar tools and easier unique special features. But Power BI has more robust tools for data sources, connections, and representations.

Ques.3) Which data model is best for Qlik Sense?

Ans. When it comes to data modeling in Qlik Sense, the best option is to use the star schema model for better performance. Qlik Sense works very well when the data is loaded in a deformalized form, thus the star schema is suitable for Qlik Sense development

Conclusion

Both Power BI and Qlik Sense are powerful data visualization and business intelligence tools that offer a wide range of features and capabilities. Ultimately, the choice between the two will depend on the specific needs and preferences of the organization or user. Power BI may be a better choice for organizations looking for a more user-friendly interface and easier data preparation capabilities, while Qlik Sense may be a better choice for organizations with more advanced data modeling and customization needs.
